title: Moving Between Loop+ Membership Plans
content:
Desk training note on plan switches within the Loop+ Membership family.

**Rule.** A move from a monthly plan to an annual plan takes effect immediately: the annual fee is charged and the unused calendar days of the current monthly cycle are refunded as a switch credit. A move from an annual plan takes effect at the end of the term. A move onto a plan that requires eligibility proof needs accepted proof first.

A switch keeps the same membership and changes its plan; after the switch the membership shows the new plan, its paid-through date after the switch and its next renewal after the switch.

## Questions the rule answers

**When does a move from a monthly Loop+ plan to an annual Loop+ plan take effect?**
Immediately. The annual fee of the new plan is charged at once, recorded as a plan switch charge.

**What happens to the part of the monthly fee already paid?**
The unused calendar days of the current monthly cycle are refunded as a switch credit. The credit is sized in calendar days of the current monthly cycle, not in whole months.

**When does a move away from an annual Loop+ plan take effect?**
At the end of the term. The move does not take effect on the day it is requested.

**What is needed to move onto a plan that requires eligibility proof?**
Accepted proof first. A move onto a Loop+ plan that requires eligibility proof needs accepted proof before the move is made.

## Summary by direction

| Direction of the move | Takes effect | Fee and refund at the move |
|---|---|---|
| From a monthly plan to an annual plan | immediately | the annual fee is charged; the unused calendar days of the current monthly cycle are refunded as a switch credit |
| From an annual plan | at the end of the term | — |
| Onto a plan that requires eligibility proof | accepted proof is needed first | — |
